sample_unit: radiology reports (brain MRI, preoperative brain tumor patients)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 versus neuroradiologists and general radiologists on same report text
links.effect: GPT-4 final diagnostic accuracy 73% vs radiologists 65-79%; differential diagnosis accuracy 94% vs radiologists 73-89%.
links.quote: In a study analyzing 150 radiological reports, GPT-4 achieved a final diagnostic accuracy of 73%, while radiologists' accuracy ranged from 65 to 79%.

screen.reason: Retrospective reader-comparative study evaluating GPT-4's diagnostic performance against radiologists on real-world MRI text reports without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
